# Orbbt — Job Application Tracker

Orbbt is a job hunt organizer for students, graduates, career switchers and active job seekers.
It provides: job tracking (Kanban board and table), company directory, contact management, deadline reminders, a Chrome browser extension for LinkedIn and Indeed, and AI Resume Job Match.

## Product
- Web app: https://web.orbbt.app
- Marketing site: https://orbbt.app
- Pricing: Free plan (unlimited job tracking) + Pro at $7.99/month or $59.99/year
- Chrome extension: Google Chrome and Chromium browsers (LinkedIn and Indeed support)
- Mobile: iOS and Android app

## Features
- Unlimited job tracking
- Kanban board and jobs table views
- Company directory and profiles
- Contacts linked to jobs (recruiters, hiring managers, referrals)
- Browser extension for one-click job saving
- Deadline reminders (push on mobile, email on Pro)
- AI Resume Job Match (3 free, 30/month on Pro)
